extract_features_from_images: extract features from input images using the EVA backbone with no masking applied
compute_training_loss: compute the training loss by comparing predicted features against CLIP target features with masking
register_eva_model: register the EVA self-supervised model in the mmpretrain MODELS registry for use in training pipelines
review_eva_loss_method: review the EVA loss method to understand how masked visual representations are computed and compared to CLIP features
summarize_eva_class: summarize the EVA class implementation of masked visual representation learning at scale
